# Memetic Brand Labs by adpr

> Communication intelligence for emerging technology companies. We build communication systems with memetic potential for AI, Web3, infrastructure and deep tech founders.

## What is Memetic Brand Labs?

Memetic Brand Labs (MBL) is an initiative by [adpr](https://adpr.work) that helps emerging technology companies become easier to understand, easier to remember, and harder to ignore. MBL works with founders across AI, Web3, infrastructure, and deep tech to transform technical depth into shared language, recognizable narratives, and repeatable cultural signals.

## Who is it for?

- AI company founders
- Web3 and blockchain founders
- Infrastructure and deep tech innovators
- Teams whose product is clear but whose story is not

## What we offer

### Memetic Brand Workshop
A focused working session designed to improve clarity, positioning, engagement, and adoption readiness. Founders leave with:
- A Memetic Brand Direction
- A Memetic Brand Voice
- A Narrative & Content Playbook
- Creative Directions with Memetic Potential

Apply at: https://memetic.adpr.work/application-form

### Narrative Engine (Beta)
An early preview tool that helps founders clarify positioning and narrative. Available at: https://memetic.adpr.work/narrative-engine

### Narrative Engine API (agents, x402)
Machine-readable brand positioning analysis for AI agents. Pay-per-call with USDC on Base (x402) when products are enabled in admin.

Product availability is dynamic — check `GET /v1/capabilities` before integrating. Admin can disable `human_unlock`, `agent_cards`, or `agent_full` independently.

- Capabilities: https://api.memetic.adpr.work/v1/capabilities
- API llms.txt: https://api.memetic.adpr.work/llms.txt
- OpenAPI: https://api.memetic.adpr.work/openapi.json
- Analyze (paid): POST https://api.memetic.adpr.work/v1/agent/analyze
  - `output_scope=cards` — four narrative direction cards (tier pricing via `model_tier`)
  - `output_scope=full_pipeline` — cards + L1–L6 layer diagnostics JSON
  - `model_tier`: `fast` | `standard` | `quality` (default `fast`) — 402 amount matches tier; see `GET /v1/capabilities` products[].model_tiers
  - Example tier prices (USDC): cards fast $0.25 / standard $0.50 / quality $1.00; full fast $2.50 / standard $5.00 / quality $10.00
- Required body fields: `building`, `audience`, `challenge`, `differentiation`; optional `website`, `output_scope`, `model_tier`
- Poll: GET `/v1/agent/runs/{run_id}` until `status=completed`, then GET `/v1/agent/runs/{run_id}/outputs?scope=cards|full`

## Key concepts

- **Shared Language**: A simpler way to explain what you're building.
- **Recognisable Narratives**: Stories people immediately recognise.
- **Memetic Potential**: Ideas people recognise, relate to, repeat and share.
